subject.title: Add DevBuild identity marker check to CI

question: Who should land the workflow-file follow-up given the prior workflow-scope push failure?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the remaining edit is under .github/workflows and prior automation could not push it without workflow scope.

options.title: Maintainer applies workflow edit
options.body: A maintainer with workflow-file permissions adds the requested CI step and runs the required validation.

options.title: Authorize workflow-scoped repair
options.body: Maintainers provide a workflow-scoped path for automation to open the narrow PR without hand-editing the workflow.

recommendation.title: Maintainer applies workflow edit
